at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Round any monetary Decimal result with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

last_failure.review_comment: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

at-0002.title: Convert unit prices with to_money before storing
at-0002.content: In ledgerly/invoice.py, always pass unit_price through to_money() from ledgerly.money before constructing a LineItem, so floats and other inputs become Decimal and invalid amounts raise BillingError.

at-0004.content: When validating integer quantities in ledgerly, check isinstance(quantity, bool) first and then isinstance(quantity, int), because bool is a subclass of int and True would otherwise pass.
